method: https://github.com/globalwordnet/english-wordnet/releases/download/2025-edition/english-wordnet-2025-json.zip: every noun.*.json, synset 00015568-n and its hyponyms, each linked to the wikidata-animals or wikidata-dog-breeds thing its Wikidata ID names; 00015568-n itself to Q729, as it carries no Wikidata ID (Claude, 2026-10-24); a Wikidata ID that isn't loaded linked instead to the one loaded taxon its P13176 (truthy) names, and left unjoined, its loaded taxa listed, when it names several
